name: Persicaria S.E.
quote: She inherits the blade of the remnant will, reflecting a bloody sunset.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. Did you sleep well last night? I've already set aside the important documents, so you can handle them at your leisure. Or, if you want to slack off a little, you can let me take care of them. After all, I need to show you how much I've grown, no?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Professor, would you like to take a short nap or have a cup of coffee to lift your spirits? This is a new way of brewing it that I've discovered. How is it? The sugar content is half of what it used to be. Hehe, you look much better now. This blend is just for you, and I'll slowly tailor it to better suit you.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: That's the Medical Department's equipment diagnostics, the Security Department's personnel transfers, the perimeter defense works progress... Ah, Professor, you startled me, I didn't know you were here. Thank you for bringing this coffee along—No, I'm fine, I don't need rest. If possible, I'd rather have you stay here and keep me company. I feel much more at ease that way.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: (Yawn) I'm getting a little sleepy. Ah, don't worry, I'm not overdoing it. Hm... I guess it's because I got too into things during the daytime. Do you have anything else that needs to be done? Allow me to share your burden, and then—and then we'll both turn in early together, how about that?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: In the past there weren't many decisions I had to make, but now that I'm handling work that's really important, I've come to realize that the world seems to have become a bigger place. I see, so this is what it's like when I go from walking behind you to walking beside you.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: We're always told not to keep obsessing about the past that we can't forget and move forward. I once tried hard to shed the past, but at some point, perhaps from the moment I picked up this sword, I suddenly realized... thinking about the past and moving toward to the future might not be a choice, but two sides of the same coin.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor, are you spacing out? Ah, you've fallen asleep... Have a good rest, then. Just relax and let me take care of the rest.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Hm? I was just about to go for a combat acclimation drill. I've improved quite a bit, going from a researcher to a frontline fighter. Would you like to see the results of my training, Professor?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Did the weapons that she held burn as hot as this...?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Is there a big change from my original look? Well, that's part of growth, too. I'm just glad you don't find it strange...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Please... pat my head more.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I'll bring a triple espresso for my shift this time.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text:
I finally made it, Professor. Are you alright?
This is Persicaria, standing by your side from this day forth—I will not allow destiny to take anything else away from me.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Building things up slowly is important, too.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I can still do much, much more.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I am no longer lost. For the sake of everything that can no longer be taken back, for the sake of everything we can still save... Let us go forth together.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Armed module debugging complete.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Enemy sighted, location verified, commencing extermination operation!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: I'll cut open a path to the future!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Let's form up and check our battle damage, everyone.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: So this is how sharp this blade used to be.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Even though I've come so far...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Is this... an oath? Thank you... If only I'd been the one to mention it. You might not have noticed, but you've been saving me, over and over again. So please, allow me to come to you of my own accord, and stay by your side forever. And never shall we be parted, until the day we leave the cloud.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. I believe some regions have a tradition of holding a vigil to welcome the new year. That is to say, they stay up all night until the dawn comes. I wonder how much coffee they have to burn for such an event... Have you tried it before? Sleeping early is a good choice, too. Whether you choose to celebrate or go to bed, I'll make sure to keep you company while doing it.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Professor, I tried making some chocolate. It's the same hazelnut and raspberry jam flavor as before, but I made it a little differently this time... I put in extra practice sessions for it. I'm sure it won't disappoint. So, if you're getting chocolates from other people, could you give me your opinion on mine first?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: I once heard that a Tanabata summer night ought to be as cool and welcoming as water. I'm sure watching the stars on a night like this would be very romantic. For a pair of lovers who can only see each other once a year on this day, every day they spend apart must be lonely and miserable. Therefore, we should cherish each day that we can spend in each other's company...

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Halloween is here, Professor. While I'd normally be scrambling to get candy ready for the kids, I've already prepared it ahead of time—Therefore, I think putting on a festive costume and getting myself a few treats that aren't coffee shouldn't be too childish, right? I just want to be a little greedy for once... So could I have some, Professor?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: I wonder how the coffee will taste with some maple syrup in it... hm? Ah, you're here, Professor. This is the syrup I was planning to use for Christmas dinner... I was just planning to add a drop or two to the coffee. It won't be excessive, it already has a lot of brown sugar in it. Would you like to try some? Ah, not that one! I meant the desserts that were—It's very sweet, isn't it? Merry Christmas, Professor.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. I'm glad that you met us, because having you around is what allowed the Oasis to come this far. Thank you for everything you've done for us. I'll do everything I can to help share your load... And then, just for today, could we celebrate together?

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud.

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Professor, are you there? These are today's documents. I've already replied to the low-priority and daily reports. I've also suggested plans for some of them and these... Hm? You trust my decisions? Hehe, thank you. In that case, you don't have to worry about the rest. I've grown a lot during this time, and if I can help you out, it'll have been worth it. If there's anything else I can do to assist you, I'll put all my effort into it.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
We've got a lot of work today, so I'll reward myself with a few extra cubes of sugar... Let's see, eight, nine, ten—Huh? Professor? When did you get back? I guess you saw a less than mature side of myself. Hm? You found it cute? You're teasing me again, Professor... In that case, this cup of coffee is yours.
...You say it tastes like when the Oasis was just built? Hehehe, what a vivid metaphor. Back then, I kept giving myself extra work out of habit, thinking that I could endure anything. Although the truth is that I was just using the work to mask my uneasiness. It was as though I could run away from all the problems I couldn't face as long as I put my nose to the grindstone long enough... But now, I'm able to treat myself better. So, here; I made a new cup of coffee for you. How is it?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Professor, are you there? I'm a little unsure about these arrangements, could you help me take a look at them...
Ah, I see, it makes more sense to handle them like that. Although I've accumulated quite a lot of experience, you're still the best at cutting to the heart of the matter. Hehe, looks like I still have a lot to learn—Realizing that fills me with motivation.
Don't worry, Professor. I'm not struggling at all. In my free time, whenever I take hold of that sword, I can feel a warm strength supporting me... So I swear, I'll make sure I take care of all this.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
What do you think the Oasis will be like in the future? To me right now, the Oasis is no longer just a foothold for us on Magrasea, but a refuge filled with countless precious memories.
When I was first uploaded to the cloud, I knew nothing about the future. In my cluelessness, I lost someone important to me... and so I continued fumbling my way forward, until I had to face loss once again. It took a long, long time for me to find my direction and it's a good thing you were there to guide me all this time. The truth is, even now, there are still many things I don't understand about you, and about the entire cloud. But I won't lose my way any more. That's because of the friends that have already fallen, and the ones who are still by my side. No matter where the future may take me...

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
The truth is, I can still feel a phantom pain coming from the depths of my neural cloud, even now. Do humans feel pain in their hearts? What does this pain bring us? For me, at least, it urges me on, tells me that I can't just stay still, that I have to work hard and keep moving forward. That I have to hold on tight to my memories, and carry on, step by step. Professor... Is this wrong?
Hehe, that does sound like something you'd say. If I don't want to reveal my weak self again, if even the strongest coffee doesn't help—can I seek you out and confess these feelings to you again, like this? Even if it's just sitting together in silence for a while, it calms my heart like a miracle. That's something only you can do. In that case, it's a promise then, Professor. For the rest of this long, long road... I'll be counting on you.

voices.label: Understanding
voices.text: I got it.

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: Mm-hmm, indeed that's the case...

voices.label: Live2D
voices.text: Ah, you're here, Professor. You startled me.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: I wonder if the Professor will like my outfit today? I went out of my way to get it ready by today... Huh? Professor?! W-What are you doing here so early...

voices.label: Good afternoon
voices.text: Ugh... My legs are getting a little sore after standing for so long... Hm? You want to give me a massage, Professor?! Then... I'll be in your care.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Ah, my heels... Can you help me put them on?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Hmm... It's getting late. Are you not planning to rest yet, Professor? In that case... Would you allow me this moment of selfishness and let me have you all to myself during the final moments of this year?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Ehhh? P-Professor?! ...Noooo, don't look! I'm still getting ready... Aiieee! Ow... That hurt...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Professor, these aren't cat ears, but digital signal processors that filter out random noise. But if that's what you like... Meow? How was that?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Maybe I can adjust my shoes while there's nobody around... Ngh...

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Um... Professor, could you give that back? It feels a little drafty...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Professor... You're so... eager...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Professor, does this intrigue you? I don't mind... if you come a little closer...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Mmm... That feels a little weird.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Professor, we're still working right now...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 4
voices.text: Ah, no! That's not what I meant...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Do I have to keep working today... No matter, I made some coffee beforehand. Would you like to try some, Professor? I strongly recommend this caffè corretto, or perhaps this sorghum latte is more to your taste.

voices.label: Acquisition
voices.text: I hear the fireworks and firecrackers already. Looks like it'll be a lively night for the Oasis. Though, there's still some time before the banquet starts... Professor, might you stay with me for a while?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Could you please not disturb us on an important day like this?

voices.label: Start Combat
voices.text: Ending target search. Now commencing intruder elimination.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: My blazing arrow pierces all!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Everyone, let's get back to the party.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Self-invited guests are not welcome in the Oasis.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Ack... I failed...

voices.label: Special Affection 1
voices.text: Aiiiieeee!

voices.label: Special Affection 2
voices.text: Ack... Owowow...

voices.label: Special Affection 3
voices.text: Mm... zzzz~

voices.label: Special Affection 4
voices.text: Mm... zzz...

voices.label: Live2D
voices.text: Hm? You want to give me a massage, Professor?! Then... I'll be in your care.

career:
Persicaria is a Doll designed by the scientist Professor Persica, whom she is named after, to handle AI research and miscellaneous support work as her creator's assistant.

After taking part in Project Neural Cloud and experiencing a series of events, Antonina performed a series of adjustments to Persicaria's combat modules at her own request so she could better adapt to more complex combat environments and meet more varied battle requirements. With the aid of a neural net weapon, a modified high-energy taser blade, Persicaria has switched from a long-range medical support mode to an offensive combat mode.

Although both her combat style and neural projection have changed, Persicaria remains the Professor's assistant, and her neural cloud's growth has allowed her to take on more managerial duties.
infoStories:
In order to address the increasingly complex and dangerous state of Magrasea, Persicaria entertained the idea of enhancing her fighting power a long time ago. However, the Oasis faced many challenging situations and Persicaria found it difficult to take the time to fully research a combat system that suited her. The advent of the divergent neural cloud system offered her the opportunity to realize her ideas.

As the first individual to realize a divergent neural cloud, Persicaria had to put in a level of effort in adaptation training that most could hardly imagine. The process was not as easy as simply switching tools; it required Persicaria to discard her long-held preconceptions of herself as a supporter and quickly alter herself to match the tempo of an attacker. Additionally, she had to change her prior habits and adjust to using a modified neural net weapon in a brand new way. With the help of Antonina and Croque, Persicaria spent just about all her rest time in the Oasis training fields. The practice yard that bore the scars of Alsvid and Arvak once again saw the keen glint of those twin blades.

Based on the estimate of the arms development group Agents, Persicaria would need a long time to complete her adaptation training. However, she completed those arrangements with shocking speed, possibly due to her desire to protect those near and dear to her. When she once again took to the battlefield, she was every bit as capable as her previous self was at healing. Though she had revealed her blade, she was still kind and strong as ever.

After taking into account Persicaria's performance in combat drills, the Medical Department arranged for a comprehensive psychological evaluation for her. Although her training results were impressive, her nonstop efforts seemed a little too obsessive. Fortunately, the results of the diagnosis were fully positive, and everyone no longer had to worry that she was taking on too much pressure for herself.

In light of this revelation, Persicaria's friends in the Oasis also began to discover how she had changed from before. Although the reports from the agents were varied, they all pointed to the fact that everyone felt Persicaria had grown more relaxed. She had grown in more than just her combat abilities; she seemed more comfortable in handling her official duties, too. Many tasks which would have needed a long time for decision-making and management were quickly handled in a more appropriate manner. Similarly, Persicaria no longer froze up under pressure when faced with unexpected developments. She was more open-minded and decisive when it came to resolving issues.

Naturally, the same thing also applied outside of work. While Persicaria still enjoyed adding large quantities of sugar to her coffee, she made quite a few interesting adjustments to her blending and brewing methods. Many agents who would normally have kept a respectable distance from her coffee were now willing to give it a try. Of course, they still had to be careful not to take the cup she made for herself.

Persicaria's growth and changes showed themselves in many aspects, but the most obvious difference was in her combat outfit. Compared to her previous style of dress which better suited a researcher, Persicaria's current attire made her appear keener and sharper, allowing the previously athletics-averse Persicaria to move with more agility. Its special structure and composition gave her better defensive abilities and helped her to better control her weapons.

Though her functional abilities had been enhanced, there were times when she was not fully used to the change in style. Fortunately, everyone was very accepting of it. In truth, this combat attire was modeled after a certain experimental 42Lab battle dress uniform. Since there was no opportunity to make use of it, this outfit remained at the experimental stage. Persicaria brought the design plans to the cloud, but there had been no chance to actually put it to use until now.

In the past, Persicaria had tried putting the experimental uniform on during a certain time of crisis in order to save her friends. However, Persicaria's mind had been in a completely different state compared to how she was now, and she was unable to pull off a miracle back then. After that, the outfit had been locked away along with that part of her past—until she finally realized that it was not just a sword, or a set of clothes, or a simple wish that could protect her friends. She also needed a will that could fearlessly face the future, and a soul that had been honed and hardened enough to face the bitterness of reality.

Persicaria was once silent about her past. It was a scar on her heart that would not fade easily, the first time such intense pain had been engraved on her neural cloud. Persicaria's anxiety and guilt were like a plug in a volcano's caldera, hidden beneath her kind smile and a frantic need to immerse herself in work. Perhaps time might have healed that wound, but losing a friend once again and bidding farewell to someone who had been near and dear to her completely cut off any avenue of escape for her.

That critical event changed many things forever. After a long period of struggle and soul-searching, Persicaria decided that she would take on and carry out more responsibilities, rather than simply carrying on as an assistant to an actual decision-maker.

With far too many things waiting for her to do, she would have to grow through struggle. The circumstances would not permit her to quietly shoulder the blame for everything. The Professor's and the Oasis' existence gave her enough peace of mind to discard her weakness of indecisiveness due to overthinking matters, and so she began to rapidly change herself. When she finally gathered up the courage to face Lind, who had once again paid the Oasis a visit, she discovered that the current Lind had gained reliable friends, and her attitude toward the past had also changed from before. From that moment on, Persicaria realized that she and Lind had found salvation for themselves in the fact that they could both trust others.

This growth and change might have been overly painful, but this time, Persicaria would no longer hesitate while wallowing in guilt.

Before connecting to Eosphorus' fragment, Persicaria did not realize that the opportunity for change would have come so soon. Having only just pulled herself out of despair, her time spent inside the fragment pushed her to rebuild herself. With sword in hand, she hacked through the obstacles in her way and carved a brand new path for herself through the Entropic hordes, and at the end of that path, she successfully defended her "irreplaceable pillar".

It was this desperate gamble which allowed Persicaria to regain her confidence in facing the future and gave the Oasis much valuable combat data. After the incident, not only had Persicaria developed and honed herself, but she had also grown closer to her friends. Although they weren't sure what had happened to Persicaria, she seemed more willing to open herself up to others now.

Though her friends' reactions ranged between helping her to teasing her, they all stemmed from a place of love and kindness. After her change, Persicaria seems to have become a little braver, too. Although she retains a bit of shyness and reservation, her trust and her feelings she gives others are one of a kind.

"I will be the master of my future, and I will travel towards it by your side."
—Persicaria, in a newly-added audio clip
oathDesc: Though the road is long, she will accompany you on it towards the future.

projections.name: Tempered Heart
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Do I... look different from before? While I'm not quite used to it yet, I've made up my mind to walk this path."

projections.name: Tempered Heart
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Do I... look different from before? While I'm not quite used to it yet, I've made up my mind to walk this path."

projections.name: Light-Quenched Edge
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"For the sake of the tomorrow that everyone wants where we'll never be sad again—Let us go forward together, hand in hand. Professor, I will defend you with the blade that I wield."

skinList.name: Salient Danger
skinList.desc: The surging fighting spirit that swells between each intense battle is what keeps each Doll going until the very end. Be it on the attack or defense, no matter how good or bad the situation is, their memories have been reproduced in Magrasea through this projection— Bullets punch through the door and narrowly graze her skin as Persicaria holds her breath. "I'll commit every scar in this place to memory and take good care of the evidence you left behind... someday, I'll pluck the mask from the killer's face."

skinList.name: Pendent Aria
skinList.desc:
The Dolls change into meticulously chosen outfits, waving goodbye to the last year amidst the sound of firecrackers and worldly delights.
Between windows dotted with lights, a tipsy countenance becomes clear. At the sight of your arrival, her eyes swell with embarrassment and a buried elation.
""I hear the fireworks and firecrackers already. Looks like it'll be a lively night for the Oasis. Though there's still some time before the banquet starts... Professor, might you stay with me for a while?

skinList.name: Imperatrix Inferni
skinList.desc:
Inheriting the Demon Lord's power and poor fortune, with the visage of a queen over all that is infernal, she is born anew from the boundless darkness. Bearing a great crossbow imbued with crimson will, she shall saturate, tear apart and crush that which is truly evil.
"Even from the abyss, burdened by torment, allow me... to always watch over you, wherever you may be."
